components.name: BarChart
limitations: This profile only declares the chart kinds with an actual bound renderer. Other OpenUI chart exports are not implied.
components.docs: Series(name, values) is data, not a UI child. Every values array has exactly one value per category. Negative values require a zero baseline.

examples.description: Minimal bar-chart example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = BarChart("Quarterly", ["Q1", "Q2"], [Series("Revenue", [20, 30])])

components.name: Text
components.docs: Use for prose. Newlines remain text; markup and code are not executed.

examples.description: Minimal text example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Text("Hello")

components.name: Heading
components.docs: Use headings in a meaningful outline. Level defaults to 2 in the renderer.

examples.description: Minimal heading example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Heading("Overview", 2)

components.name: Badge
components.docs: A badge displays a supplied label; tone does not independently verify status.

examples.description: Minimal badge example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Badge("Draft", "muted")

components.name: Divider
components.docs: Use sparingly between sections. It has no text or interaction.

examples.description: Minimal divider example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Divider()

components.name: Alert
components.docs: Passive notice. It does not trigger a notification service or infer urgency.

examples.description: Minimal alert example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Alert("Note", "Data is supplied", "muted")

components.name: Table
components.docs: Columns have unique keys. Rows may omit a column, but may not introduce undeclared columns. Cells are plain scalar data.

examples.description: Minimal table example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Table([{key: "name", label: "Name"}], [{name: "Ada"}], "People")

components.name: Button
limitations: No host tools, navigation, account access or message sending.
components.docs: onPress is a runtime-issued local action. Use @Set, @Reset or Action; literal action-like objects are forbidden.

examples.description: Minimal button example using supplied data.
examples.source:
$count = 0
root = Button("Reset", @Reset($count), "secondary")

components.name: Input
components.docs: Pass a direct declared $variable to value to allow edits. Literal values render read-only. Draft text is not committed when validation fails.

examples.description: Minimal input example using supplied data.
examples.source:
$answer = ""
root = Input("Name", $answer, "Your name")

components.name: Textarea
components.docs: Writable through a direct declared $variable; an invalid transaction must preserve the previous committed value.

examples.description: Minimal textarea example using supplied data.
examples.source:
$notes = ""
root = Textarea("Notes", $notes, 4)

components.name: Select
components.docs: Options have unique values. Current value must match one option.

examples.description: Minimal select example using supplied data.
examples.source:
$choice = "a"
root = Select("Choice", $choice, [{label: "A", value: "a"}])

components.name: RadioGroup
components.docs: Uses the same single-choice state contract as Select, with native labeled radios.

examples.description: Minimal radio example using supplied data.
examples.source:
$choice = "a"
root = RadioGroup("Choice", $choice, [{label: "A", value: "a"}])

components.name: Checkbox
components.docs: Pass a direct declared boolean $variable to checked for local edits.

examples.description: Minimal checkbox example using supplied data.

root = Checkbox("Enabled", $enabled)

components.name: Switch
components.docs: A boolean local switch. It never changes external account or app settings.

examples.description: Minimal switch example using supplied data.

root = Switch("Enabled", $enabled)

components.name: Slider
components.docs: Requires finite min < max and value inside the range. Step is positive and cannot exceed the range.

examples.description: Minimal slider example using supplied data.

components.name: Icon
limitations: No remote SVG or arbitrary path data.

examples.description: Minimal icon example using supplied data.

components.name: Stack
components.docs: Children belong to the selected profile. Gap is a finite design token; there is no arbitrary CSS.

examples.description: Minimal stack example using supplied data.

components.name: Row
components.docs: Uses a wrapping row. Choose start, center, end or stretch alignment.

components.name: Grid
components.docs: Columns is a maximum requested column count; narrow layouts may use fewer columns.

examples.description: Minimal grid example using supplied data.

components.name: Card
components.docs: Use a card for one coherent section. Card owns its child slot, not external services.

examples.description: Minimal card example using supplied data.
